# SPONTÁN — VIPACH Photo Exhibition 2026

Official multilingual microsite for the VIPACH — Vienna Photo Art & Creative Hub group exhibition in Vienna.

- Exhibition: SPONTÁN
- Dates: 15–22 November 2026
- Opening: 15 November 2026, 17:00 (Europe/Vienna)
- Venue: CITYgalleryVIENNA by publicartists, Mahlerstraße 11, 1010 Vienna, Austria
- Organizer: VIPACH — Vienna Photo Art & Creative Hub
- Languages: English, German (Austria), Hungarian
- Official VIPACH website: https://www.vipach.at/

## Language pages
- English: https://exhibition.vipach.at/
- German: https://exhibition.vipach.at/de/
- Hungarian: https://exhibition.vipach.at/hu/

The exhibition is VIPACH’s third major group exhibition in Vienna and presents the participating community’s own photographic perspectives after a learning year focused on major figures and movements in photography history.


## Previous group exhibitions
1. As I Like It Austria — 30 November–6 December 2025, CITYgalleryVIENNA, Vienna
   - HU: https://www.vipach.at/asilikeit
   - EN: https://www.vipach.at/asilikeit?lang=en-GB
   - DE: https://www.vipach.at/asilikeit?lang=de
2. Életem képe / Picture of My Life — 7–13 December 2025, CITYgalleryVIENNA, Vienna
   - HU: https://www.vipach.at/eletemkepe
   - EN: https://www.vipach.at/eletemkepe?lang=en-GB
   - DE: https://www.vipach.at/eletemkepe?lang=de
